import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import time

source_path = Path('/tmp/astra-pass97-verifier.py')
manifest_path = Path('/tmp/astra-pass97-inputs.json')
history_path = Path('/tmp/astra-pass97-attempts.jsonl')
source = source_path.read_text()
manifest = manifest_path.read_text()
argv = ['python3', '-B', str(source_path)]
started = time.monotonic()
result = subprocess.run(argv, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
record = {
    'argv': argv,
    'verifier_source': source,
    'verifier_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),
    'manifest_text': manifest,
    'manifest_sha256': hashlib.sha256(manifest.encode()).hexdigest(),
    'exit_code': result.returncode,
    'stdout': result.stdout,
    'stderr': result.stderr,
    'check_elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - started,
}
with history_path.open('a') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'exit_code': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout,
                  'stderr': result.stderr, 'history': str(history_path)}, indent=2))
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
